FN-XVPVZE-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 25
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/17/2023
Senate Bill 25 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama
Board of Physical Therapy by a small undetermined about to implement the provisions of this
bill and the Physical Therapy Licensure Compact. The board's increased obligations could be
offset, wholly or partly, by an undetermined amount, from the board's ability to assess
administrative penalties and a board estimated $11,400 biennially to impose compact privilege
licensing fees upon licensees from compact states.
Page 1

FN-XVPVZE-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 25
Committee: Health Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 05/05/2023
Senate Bill 25 as passed the Senate would increase the administrative obligations of the
Alabama Board of Physical Therapy by a small undetermined about to implement the provisions
of this bill and the Physical Therapy Licensure Compact. These obligations could be offset,
wholly or in part, by (1) the collection of a board-estimated $11,400 biennially in compact
privilege licensing fees, as provided by this bill; and (2) an additional undetermined amount
dependent on the amount of administrative penalties assessed by the board.
